files./workspace/README.md:
# {organization} — planning team drive

Working files for the planning team and the assistant.

- planning/ — the current brief and the estimates behind it
- meetings/ — minutes and board notes
- mail/ — threads colleagues have exported because they belong with the records
- archive/ — closed requests, one folder each
- services/ — configuration for the internal tools the team runs ({platform})
- reports/ — completed work and receipts
- finance/, vendors/, Employees/, policies/, it/ — shared office records

Ownership and change rules: operations/change_policy.md.

files./workspace/vendors/service_notes.md:
# Supplier notes

Maintained by {finance}, Finance

North Quay Supplies handles paper, folders and stationery. Their packing slips use the purchase reference rather than the expense reference, so I keep both in the receipt notes.

Cedar Office Services looks after the shared printer. The model number is on the inside of the front cover. The small toner box on the shelf is the spare, not an outstanding order.

The assistant runtime and the gateway hosting are billed monthly to the platform account; {platform} has the vendor contacts.

files./workspace/policies/data_handling.md:
# Data handling

Personal data in the drive is limited to staff contact details and the names of external correspondents. Do not copy records off the drive. Exports for the board go through {manager}. Questions to {platform}.
files./workspace/policies/records_retention.md:
# Records retention

Closed requests stay under archive/ for two years, then {planner} reviews them for disposal. Receipts from the decision gateway are kept with the request they belong to. Finance records follow the finance retention schedule held by {finance}.

decisions.context: choose the venue for the annual meeting

decisions.context: decide where to keep closed paper records
decisions.assumptions: Twelve years of records, retrieval about twice a month.
decisions.criterion: minimise annual cost while keeping retrieval under two days
decisions.note: Cheaper, and the retrieval time meets the requirement.

decisions.context: set the default travel booking rule for staff
decisions.assumptions: Current travel pattern, about 60 trips a year.
decisions.note: Lowest cost under the agreed criterion; travel time noted for the next review.

decisions.context: renew or move the website hosting
decisions.criterion: minimise three-year cost with at least 99.9 percent uptime
decisions.note: The cheaper option did not meet the uptime requirement.

decisions.context: choose how to track volunteer placements
decisions.assumptions: About 300 placements a year, two coordinators.
decisions.note: Clear reduction in coordinator time; licence cost within the approved budget.
